annotations.title: Stock and crypto returns by market regime

description: How has this stock or crypto typically done in markets like today's? Returns, for one stock or crypto symbol per call (any US stock, plus the covered crypto list), its typical return and how often it rose over 1 to 12 months from the current regime. Stocks add sensitivity versus the S&P 500 and up to 5 peer symbols. A symbol with no price data is free, not covered. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Settled figures, updated after each US close (coins daily). The same figures as the symbol's page on regimecard.com. Useful when an agent needs stock returns by market regime or crypto returns by market regime for one holding.

inputSchema.description: A JSON object with exactly one field: symbol, or the earlier symbols with one entry. One symbol per call. A second symbol is a second call.

symbol.description: One stock or crypto symbol: any US stock, or a coin on the covered crypto list, for example "NVDA" or "BTC". Upper or lower case. One symbol per call.

symbols.description: The earlier form of the same input: a list with exactly one stock or crypto symbol, for example ["NVDA"].

items.description: One stock, ETF or crypto symbol.
